svg.text: WSurf identity specimen - Flux (DRAFT, needs approval)
Generated from branding/assets; fonts: Figtree Bold (OFL) outlined. Labels below are specimen text only, not the logo.
Light surface #F5F5F7, ink #1D1D1F, light palette set
Dark surface #1C1C1E, ink #F5F5F7, dark palette set
2 Clear space = 1/4 of mark width (x) on all sides; Dock/app fit separately
Lockup: same x (1/4 of the mark width) around the whole lockup
Minimum: lockup 96 px wide; mark 16 px (small geometry <=48 px, flat)
3 Size ramp - small geometry (flat, 2 colour) up to 48 px, master above
4 Six palettes: Dock-tile previews (illustrative, not final masks) - smooth row, textured row; light then dark
5 One-ink mono: positive, reverse, and on brand-ink surfaces
